meta.title: `GET /api/event_groups/:id` requires read *and* a visible stage
gaps: testing a specific user without stage visibility relies on the library case EDGE-PUB-085 which models owner restriction rather than custom stage visibility roles directly

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer sends the request that reads the event, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
As the buyer, read the event and check that “status” is present.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not allowed to perform this action”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: “status” is present.

expected.message: You are not allowed to perform this action
